summary: The legal integer has at most ten decimal digits, so its complete source domain is too tightly bounded for a reliable runtime-scaling verdict.

workload_bound.source_constraint: n is an integer from 10 through 10^9 inclusive

replacement_checks.evidence: Each loop removes one decimal digit, so every legal execution performs between two and ten iterations.
Authored cases cover two-digit inputs, repeated maxima, zeros, nine digits, and the ten-digit upper boundary.
